defect.effect: The numerical QM-dipole-reproduction check incorrectly reported the frozen MACE-MDP/QM polarizability mismatch (0.003867862161286716) instead of QM-helper reproduction.
defect.location_at_execution: run_route2_v0_mace_mdp_induced_source_acetone.py: current_qm_alpha was assigned from the candidate dipole-by-step array rather than the independent QM dipole-response array.
defect.repair: Extract the selected tensor exclusively from the frozen QM helper response, with a regression test for candidate/QM separation.

prohibited_rescue_actions: do not change the 1.5 Angstrom width
do not add charge or higher multipoles
do not select a point subset
do not rescale or temper the response
do not use solvation labels or run an accuracy panel for this source
scope: This erratum preserves the original V1 raw finite-field record and corrects only a postprocessing bookkeeping defect. It changes no geometry, field step, exterior points, radial width, atomic partition, QM values, MACE-MDP values, threshold, solvent quantity, or scientific decision.

unchanged_independent_scientific_rejecti.reason: Both MEP checks are calculated independently from the source potential and frozen QM exterior-potential response. Each exceeds its preregistered ceiling, so the source remains rejected even after the numerical bookkeeping correction.
